reviews.review:
I am sorry, but the game is just boring.  It feels like everything it has to offer is already shown in the screenshots, nothing more. Yes, I spent less than an hour playing, but It just doesn't have any hooks. 

The gameplay is completely linear, the obstacles feels absolutely identical and it's all about several sliders going down, Don't get me wrong, «Sliders going down» can provide a lot of fun gameplay, but not here. And refunding this for me is a big deal, because I'm a roguelike-head and played a lot of them, including quite questionable ones. Yet here I felt absolutely empty throughout the entire play session. Worst of all, I'm not sure that content packs and what not can improve this.

It seems like the only thing meant to keep players here is pretty high difficulty in managing resources, but it is so artificial that it achieves quite the opposite. It's not even about "git gud" — I just can't see, why I should.

The art and chiptune are fine though.
